basic_info.description: Experience city living at its best from this stunning top floor, corner loft style condo! One of the largest and most desirable floorplans in the building. Amazing sun-filled unit features two full size walls of oversized floor to ceiling grand windows, in addition to multiple skylights. Truly bright and radiant throughout! Impressive, soaring high ceilings in the open concept living/dining area provide an airy and spacious feel. Recently renovated with a contemporary kitchen and two stylish bathrooms. Enjoy two bedrooms, one on each level. Private, upstairs mezzanine level, primary bedroom suite w/ bathroom. Second bedroom (or guest bedroom, office, den) located on the main level. Other highlights include a wood burning fireplace and a private balcony that directly opens off the upstairs bedroom. In-unit stacked washer and dryer. One deeded parking space (one of the widest garage parking spots!) with convenient storage units included. Additional perks include a lovely zen-like shared courtyard, bike storage room and building elevator. Located in the vibrant SOMA/South Beach/Mission Bay intersection, the City's main tech corridor! Effortless access to freeways 280, 101 and 80 and easy commute options via Caltrain and Muni. Close proximity to Oracle Park and Chase Center.
